basic_info.description: Top-floor, updated 3BR/2BA Edwardian condo with private deck, skylight, and partial downtown views. Perfect location where Cole Valley meets Haight Ashbury. Flooded with natural light, 720 Clayton has been renovated for modern living while keeping period details intact. Comforts include double-paned windows, in-unit washer and dryer, and two bathrooms. The kitchen features custom tilework, stainless steel appliances, and French doors to the private, east-facing deck. Stairs lead from the private deck to the shared garden below. Coved ceilings, built-in cabinetry, wainscoting, latticework, and hardwood floors provide warmth and character. Large ground-floor storage. Walk to shops, restaurants, MUNI, schools, and Golden Gate Park. Walk Score of 98!
